mentions.name: Beancount AI bookkeeping agent
mentions.description: An AI agent that handles bookkeeping automatically. It works with Beancount, a plain-text format for double-entry accounting, and invokes different skills depending on where it is in the process. Every entry it creates is version-controlled through Git, providing a complete history of changes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an AI agent that handles my bookkeeping automatically.
